mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_members ( project_id, employee_id, status, joined_phase, joined_at, left_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{employeeId}, #{status}, #{joinedPhase}, #{joinedAt}, #{leftAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, employee_id, status, joined_phase, joined_at, left_at FROM project_members WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE project_members SET status = 'ACTIVE', joined_phase = #{joinedPhase}, joined_at = NOW(), left_at = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
UPDATE project_members SET status = 'INACTIVE', left_at = NOW() WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT pm.id, pm.project_id, pm.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.employee_name, e.dept_id, d.dept_type, pm.status, pm.joined_phase, pm.joined_at, pm.left_at FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = pm.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN pm.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pm.joined_at DESC, pm.id DESC

SELECT pm.id, pm.project_id, pm.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.employee_name, e.dept_id, d.dept_type, pm.status, pm.joined_phase, pm.joined_at, pm.left_at FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = pm.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY pm.joined_at DESC, pm.id DESC
